description:
Measured market conditions: VIX, the 10-year minus 2-year Treasury yield, the high-yield credit spread and the CNN Fear and Greed index.

    Each reading carries its value, unit, source, as_of timestamp and freshness
    (`stale`, `stale_reason`, `age_hours`). A reading whose source failed is
    returned with `available: false` and listed in `unavailable`, while the
    others still resolve. Observations only; no verdict is attached.
name: get_market_conditions
